newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cydsa to restructure debt, issue bonds.
newsitem.headline: Cydsa to restructure debt, issue bonds.

text.p: Mexican conglomerate Cydsa SA plans to issue some $100 million in Eurobonds shortly as part of its plans to restructure debt, a company official said on Thursday.

"We are fine-tuning plans (to restructure debt). The first step is to issue Eurobonds worth about $100 million. I think in the next four weeks we will have the details worked out," Cesareo Frias, finance director of the company, told Reuters.

Cydsa, which has interests in chemicals, textiles, packaging and environmental technology, will use the money as part of an effort to restructure $400 million, much of which is in the form of syndicated loans and commercial paper.
"The company is always restructuring debt, looking to take advantage of market opportunities to lower our rates and extend maturities," he said.
